notes.title: RAGNAR – NEW DEMO AVAILABLE NOW!
notes.notes: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452595/b6f87c09a8b892234240ceb0f81b5e784710239f.png"][/img][/p][p][b]After months of development, the new demo for Ragnar is finally here — and it’s more than just an update. It’s a bold step forward that reshapes the very core of the game.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452595/5bf14d51890e5b75d941fe21cf602c783518236c.png"][/img][/p][p][b]What’s New?[/b] [/p][p]• New active and passive skills for deeper tactical choices [/p][p]• Improved storytelling with stronger character connections [/p][p]• Overhauled art style darker, richer, more immersive [/p][p]• Gameplay polish and performance improvements across the board[/p][p][/p][p]This new demo brings you closer to the chaos of Ragnarok, where every strike feels heavier, and every choice matters.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452595/0a1e01c2256ce252c2990e06aa58c415afe0ec53.png"][/img][/p][p][b]Play Now:[/b] Available for both Mac and Windows.[/p][p]Your feedback is incredibly valuable to us. Share your thoughts and help us shape the path to full release together.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452595/c9eae741cf3f103f5abcb8ca37add75bd62d2d9b.png"][/img][/p][p]The time has come. RAGNAR awaits.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45452595/814f6b43fa28593656041ee691e7892adbe24bcb.png"][/img][/p]
